assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE ordinary resident NPC static sprite for a 2D top-down factory management game, DOWN direction. Create one full-body human adult worker in a neutral standing pose, arms resting by sides, empty hands, feet visible. Simple short dark brown hair, no hat, muted olive-gray shirt with rolled sleeves, plain brown work trousers (not bib overalls), dark gray work gloves and boots. Ordinary modest working clothes, friendly neutral expression, no weapons or carried tools. Match a chunky simple pixel-art game aesthetic with broad clearly aligned square pixels, dark pixel outlines, limited flat colors, only 2-3 shading tones per material. Stocky readable proportions, slightly enlarged head, slightly elevated camera suitable for top-down gameplay while still seeing full face and body. Direction DOWN / SOUTH: front view facing the bottom of the screen. Portrait 2:3 canvas, whole body centered, consistent foot baseline at about 94% of canvas height, useful transparent margin all around. Exactly one character, one static idle pose, not a spritesheet and not walking frames. TRUE transparent background, clean hard alpha edges, no floor, no ground shadow, no colored halo, no glow, no vignette, no backdrop, no lettering, no watermark. No smooth painting, no photorealism, no tiny intricate details. The sprite should visually read as a simple low-resolution pixel character enlarged with nearest-neighbor.
